Add bounded execution observability projections (#172)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-58
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Add transport-neutral bounded Attempt and Operation observability query contracts.
    - Implement PostgreSQL Attempt list/detail, Operation list/detail, and a deterministic durable timeline across Attempt, Operation, Attention, finalization, and cleanup events.
    - Reuse the existing agent execution read model for selection, binding, dispatch, runtime, and aggregate facts.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker execution_observability -- --test-threads=1`
    - `cargo check -p codeon-tracker -p codeon-postgres --lib --all-features`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeon-tracker -p codeon-postgres --lib --all-features -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `git diff --check`
    
    PostgreSQL acceptance, restart, and production-sized EXPLAIN checks were not run because no isolated test database target was configured.
